scope: Frozen packaging/source/API and persisted selection metadata review, plus synthetic observation parity only. No simulator reset, episode, or holdout access. No conclusion about in-progress fresh validation.

checks.source_delta: AST-identical after removing selected DEFAULTS.update and docstrings; source diff only baked selected defaults and corrected clearance docstring.

synthetic_action_parity.input_method: Three sequential 45-frame synthetic curved-road sequences, occasional rectangular obstacles, varying synthetic HUD crop intensity, four-frame temporal stacks. No track images or simulator renderer used.

limitations.finding: Failed optical flow leaves slip=0; HUD yaw sets motion_valid=True but does not measure slip. Rolling predictor can therefore run with unknown slip. Prior P1 REQUIRED audit counted 433/929 valid frames. Existing selection metadata explicitly discloses this; measured outcomes remain valid.
Rolling acceleration predictor omits saturation, grass, damage and rapid steering transient effects; synthetic calibration accuracy is not lap-performance evidence.
Horizontal row constraints do not certify continuous vehicle-footprint clearance; corrected frozen docstring states this limitation.
Pre-freeze consumed development selection is not holdout corroboration. This review does not audit in-progress final driving validation or claim the original 10–13-second goal.
Review covers the frozen Python entry point, not a ZIP archive or official server submission.
